Fix the actual phone-only PPTX NotFoundError captured on the Samsung API33 device with candidate07: the bundled ImpressTileLayer._putPCWInsideFlex re-inserts #presentation-controls-wrapper into #document-container's parent (#document-and-notes) using #main-document-content's first child as reference, a node that is not a child of that parent, so the very first landscape evaluation of onResizeImpress after initialize() moved the wrapper outside the flex throws before any paint while desktop/tablet never take the small-screen branch. This narrow self-authored MPL-2.0 script is referenced by the overlaid dist/cool.html deferred after bundle.js and restores the upstream-intended placement with a structurally valid DOM move (detach from the wrapper's actual parent, then insert as the first child of #main-document-content). No desktop forcing, no error swallowing, no readiness or actual-render gate change; the shipped bundle.js and unbundled dist/src remain byte-identical upstream files.

Fix the exact phone-only Impress defect captured on the Samsung API33 C06 run (two console errors 'UIManager: Button with id "slide-presentation-follow[-me]" not found.' with the document rendered and native state READY_EDITABLE): the bundled SlideShowPresenter.showFollow unconditionally asks UIManager.showButton to toggle the two follow controls, but at the pinned revision they exist only in the Impress notebookbar gated by !window.ThisIsAMobileApp (Control.NotebookbarImpress.js) and small-screen devices never build a notebookbar (Control.UIManager.js getCurrentMode() returns 'classic'), so every phone presentation logged both errors at presenter construction. The deferred overlay restricts the two toggles to UI shapes where UIManager.showButton's own lookup (notebookbar object, or classic map.topToolbar.hasItem) would actually find the control. It adds no button, changes UIManager and its general missing-button error logging not at all, preserves stock behaviour byte-identically where the controls exist (tablet/desktop), and fails closed when the lookup throws.
